formula.conversion.name: formula.conversion
formula.conversion.description: Safe text-to-number conversion for mixed imported data and numeric projections.

VALUE.behavior: Legacy loose conversion that can extract numeric characters from surrounding text. Invalid non-numeric text produces a formula error. Do not use it as a safe mixed-column projection.

TRY_VALUE.behavior: Strictly converts a complete decimal or scientific numeric string and returns blank for empty, malformed, non-numeric, or out-of-range text.

semantics.whitespace: Leading and trailing ASCII whitespace is ignored; internal whitespace is invalid.
semantics.thousands: Comma grouping is accepted only in groups of three, for example 1,000 or 1,234,567.89.
semantics.decimals: Signed integers, 1., .5, and ordinary decimal fractions are accepted.
semantics.scientific: Scientific notation such as 1.25e3 and -2E-2 is accepted.
semantics.invalid: Currency symbols, trailing units, malformed grouping, Infinity, NaN, and values outside the finite number range return blank.

mixedImportRecipe.rawField: Keep the imported mixed-type column as single-line text so values are preserved.
mixedImportRecipe.numericProjection: Create a Formula field with TRY_VALUE({Value}) and use that numeric Formula field for charts, aggregations, and numeric formulas.

constraints: Do not change a mixed raw field to Number when textual values must be preserved.
Standard App chart aggregations require a numeric field; point them at the TRY_VALUE projection.
TRY_VALUE returns blank for invalid text, so downstream aggregates ignore those rows rather than failing.

workflow.createProjection: Create a Formula field whose expression is TRY_VALUE({Value}), then reference the new field from the App chart.

audio.security: Audio reads the first audio/* item from a Teeble Attachment field. Arbitrary URLs, HTML, JavaScript, and autoplay-on-load are not accepted.

app.code.name: app.code
app.code.description: Sandboxed per-component TypeScript/React with ECharts, SVG, D3, and permission-filtered multi-table data.
app.code.componentMode: Add type: code to one component; Visual components and Code components can coexist on every App page.

source.language: Single-file TypeScript/React TSX with one default-exported React component.
source.compiler: Strict TypeScript uses the pinned official React 18 (@types/react 18.3.31), D3 7 (@types/d3 7.4.3), and ECharts 6.1.0 declarations. Normal React.MouseEvent/forwardRef, JSX children/key, D3 line/pie/stack/scale/selection callbacks, and ECharts init/on/setOption callbacks are supported; implicit any, suppression directives, and non-allowlisted imports fail validation.
source.diagnostics: TypeScript semantic diagnostics include source, line, column, code, category, and bounded message; undefined names and type mismatches block validate/save/publish.
source.sizing: New Code blocks use heightMode auto and continuously report a bounded 160..5000px height with ResizeObserver; old blocks without heightMode remain fixed.

data.declaration: Each dataSources entry declares a static tableId, optional viewId, projection, filter, orderBy, limit, filterKeys, and bounded dataset transforms. useDataset(name) reads the initial bounded dataset; opt into queries.page/queries.aggregate for useDatasetQuery(name).
data.multiTable: Declare up to 8 independently authorized named sources per Code component from different tables; an App may declare up to 32 sources in total. join and lookup still use the bounded server-side relational transform path.
data.permission: The browser never chooses table IDs at runtime. Saved draft or immutable published declarations are resolved through canonical row and readable-field permissions.

queries.page: const rows = useDatasetQuery('tasks'); const page = await rows.page({ limit: 50 }); const next = page.nextCursor ? await rows.page({ limit: 50, cursor: page.nextCursor }) : null;
queries.aggregate: const rows = useDatasetQuery('tasks'); const total = await rows.aggregate({ operation: 'count' }); const sum = await rows.aggregate({ operation: 'sum', fieldId: 'fldAmount' });
queries.semantics: Each page contains at most 200 rows plus total/skip/take/hasMore and an offset cursor. Concurrent inserts/deletes can shift pages. Aggregates cover all authorized matching rows, independent of initial limit; count without fieldId counts rows. Sources with transforms cannot opt into runtime query execution.
queries.identity: The parent uses the saved draft or immutable published/saved release and its version fence. It combines declared runtime filters and cancels obsolete requests; Code cannot choose tables, fields outside projection, or override source declarations.

actions.behavior: Declare each named action statically on the Code component, then call useAction(name) in TSX. The parent runs the ordinary permission-checked API and returns a receipt; the sandbox never receives API credentials.

recordUpdate.usage: const saveTask = useAction('saveTask'); await saveTask({ recordId: row.__recordId, fields: { fldStatus: 'Done' } });
recordUpdate.rule: includeRecordId:true exposes __recordId and same-read recordVersions. The parent supplies the displayed version for conditional updates/deletes; missing or stale versions fail without retry. Addressable initial datasets support only filter, sort, and limit transforms.

recordCreate.usage: const createTask = useAction('createTask'); await createTask({ fields: { fldTitle: 'New task' } });
recordCreate.rule: The target source and writable fields are static. Current table create permission and explicit confirmation are required.

recordDelete.usage: const deleteTask = useAction('deleteTask'); await deleteTask({ recordId: row.__recordId });
recordDelete.rule: The row must exist in the trusted dataset with its read version. Current delete permission, confirmation, and an atomic version match are required.

workflowRun.usage: const runFollowUp = useAction('runFollowUp'); await runFollowUp({ recordId: row.__recordId, input: { note, priority } });
workflowRun.rule: Only declared inputKeys are forwarded as Workflow input. The workflowId and optional record source are fixed in the saved App source.

actions.publicShare: Published public shares are read-only. Record creation, updates, deletes, and Workflow runs are rejected. Native shared Forms keep their separate submission authority.

interaction.selection: selectionSources maps a selection key to an includeRecordId dataset. useSelection(key) reads or changes that shared record selection.
interaction.filters: Component filterKeys permits useAppFilter(key). Each data source binds filterKeys (or legacy filterKey); all bound values combine with AND alongside its View/static filters and normal row permissions.
interaction.navigation: navigate(path) moves to a declared App page; refreshData() reloads authorized datasets.

security.isolation: Code executes only in an opaque-origin iframe sandbox with allow-scripts. Its route-specific CSP blocks direct connection, form, child-frame, object, and worker APIs, while the iframe cannot access parent DOM, storage, cookies, tokens, or API clients.
security.credentials: The sandbox receives compiled code, sanitized dataset JSON, and theme only. Direct fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource, beacon, and worker primitives are removed or CSP-blocked; no plugin bridge credentials are provided.
security.trustModel: Code is trusted Base-editor-authored content. Browser iframe self-navigation cannot be reliably disabled, so declared datasets must not be treated as confidential from the Code author; only users trusted with app|update should author or publish Code.
security.compilation: The backend compilation endpoint compiles but never executes draft TSX. Save, validate, and publish compile every Code source and reject arbitrary imports or syntax errors.
security.publication: Shared Apps serve the immutable published source together with a bounded compiler-versioned artifact bundle keyed by each component source hash. Legacy, invalid, or hash-mismatched bundles are rebuilt for every Code component and conditionally repaired by publishedVersion before serving.

app.form.name: app.form
app.form.description: Native shared Form blocks with bounded uploads, protected defaults, and explicit visitor submission policy.

configuration.shareId: Use only an enabled shared Form from the same Base; do not put an arbitrary URL in an App source.
configuration.visitorPolicy: enableShare controls public access. Form submit.enabled controls whether visitors may submit; requireLogin distinguishes anonymous submission from signed-in submission.
configuration.protectedDefaults: Configure Form options.protectedDefaults as a field-ID map. The server validates same-table fields and applies these values atomically after parsing visitor input; visitor values cannot override them.
configuration.attachments: Configure Form options.attachmentLimits with maxFiles, maxSizeBytes, and allowedMimeTypes. Uploads are validated before storage and again at submit.

workflow.preview: Publish with app.publish, create/enable sharing with app.share.create and app.share.update using confirm:true, then read app.preview for the visitorUrl. Disabling revokes that URL; re-enabling creates a fresh share ID with password/save/copy settings applied atomically.

security: A Form block grants no table-read, automation|run, Workflow, or credential permission to an App share.
Never put PATs, webhook secrets, or other credentials in protectedDefaults or App source.

api.feedback.name: api.feedback
api.feedback.description: Report a reproducible Teeble CLI gap to the shared Issues workspace with dynamic lookup, deduplication, safe defaults, and read-back verification.
api.feedback.purpose: Use this entry when an agent using Teeble CLI finds a missing typed operation, unclear or contradictory discovery/schema guidance, unsafe or unstable output, or a reproducible CLI/server contract mismatch.
reportWhen: A required Teeble capability is absent from typed CLI operations and would otherwise require api.call.
help, discover, or schema output is missing, ambiguous, contradictory, or leads to an invalid request.
A stable CLI output contract is incomplete, unsafe, or difficult for an agent to consume reliably.
The current CLI and server versions have a reproducible compatibility or transport failure.
doNotReportUntilChecked: Correct input typos and compare the request with `teeble schema <resource.action>` first.
Separate authentication, permission, and transient network failures from product defects.
Capture `teeble --version` and confirm whether the CLI or server is stale before claiming a contract mismatch.
Never create sample, speculative, or duplicate issues through this workflow.

destination.resolution: Resolve every ID at runtime by exact name: find the space, find the base with that spaceId, find both tables in that base, inspect their fields, then find the project record by project name. Do not cache or hardcode workspace, base, table, field, project, or issue record IDs.

resolveTables: Require exactly one result from each exact-name lookup; stop and report zero or duplicate matches.
resolveProject: Follow data.pagination.hasMore and increase skip by take until it is false. The CLI enables includeTotal by default.
Select the single project record whose primary value is exactly "teeble". The link value used during issue creation is that record's id, not its title and not the project table id.
deduplicate: For each search, continue with skip increased by take while data.pagination.hasMore is true.
Compare both title and description with all candidates. If a materially equivalent issue exists, stop without creating or changing a record and return its URL.
workflow.create: Run the copyable record.create command below only after resolution, field inspection, and deduplication succeed.
verify: Verify every required field and confirm 项目.id equals the resolved project record id. Return the record URL; do not mark it executable or claim it.

defaults.Type: Choose Bug, Feature request, Improvement, or Documentation after field.list confirms the current choices.
defaults.rule: A feedback reporter never grants agent execution authority. Only a project owner may later change 允许 Agent 执行.

safety: Use typed CLI operations only; api.call is not part of this reporting workflow.
Create one coherent issue per independently actionable finding.
Do not include PATs, Authorization or Cookie headers, passwords, API keys, personal data, or unrelated record contents.
Describe observed evidence precisely and distinguish verified facts from hypotheses.

example.replace: Replace every angle-bracket placeholder with values resolved in this session. Keep 项目 as an object containing the target project record id.
example.create: teeble record create --input '{"tableId":"<issues-table-id>","data":{"fieldKeyType":"name","typecast":true,"records":[{"fields":{"Title":"<one-sentence reproducible title>","项目":{"id":"<project-record-id>"},"状态":"待整理","优先级":"P2 普通","Type":"Improvement","Description":"<goal, context, and observed problem>","Expected behavior":"<expected CLI behavior>","实际行为":"<actual CLI behavior and exact error or output shape>","Environment and version":"Teeble CLI <version>; <OS>; endpoint <host>; observed <UTC timestamp>","验收条件":"<specific verifiable outcomes and regression checks>","允许 Agent 执行":false,"示例数据":false}}]}}'

lookup.description: Use resource.resolve and record.find to compose fewer commands. This complements the feedback reporting guide; deduplication, creation, and owner authorization remain separate steps.

resource.lookup.name: resource.lookup
resource.lookup.description: Resolve resources by name and find exactly one record, including linked-record criteria.
rules: Names are exact and case-sensitive. All IDs are resolved on every invocation.
where maps field names to exact string, number, or boolean values; conditions combine with AND.
links resolves each field through its declared foreign table using its own where conditions. The returned linkedRecords are keyed by link field name.
Zero matches return RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND; duplicate matches return RESOURCE_AMBIGUOUS. No first-match fallback.

Reads follow pagination.hasMore. Older servers without metadata are scanned until an empty page, advancing by the actual page length. A bounded lookup fails explicitly instead of returning an incomplete match.
These commands only read. Before a later update, read record.get again and use its lastModifiedTime as expectedLastModifiedTime.

examples.resolve: teeble resource resolve --input '{"spaceName":"Issues","baseName":"项目与问题","tableName":"Issues｜问题"}'
